components.purpose: The opening/top-of-page banner itself (hero with heading, description, CTAs, background), configured with two nested 'Personalized Hero Items' — one targeted to a 'Europe' audience and one to a 'North America' audience — so the banner's heading/description text swaps based on the visitor's region. This single component covers the entire request: it's the banner, and its built-in Personalization tab (linked to the shared Audience list) is what drives the region-based text variation.
